subject: Usage dashboard undercounts calls from a partner integration
text: Our own logs show far more API calls going out than the usage dashboard reports for this month.

subject: Merging two tickets scrambled the message order
text: I merged two related tickets and now the combined thread shows replies out of chronological order.

subject: Tickets imported from Slack are missing some replies
text: A thread we imported from an old Slack channel is missing a couple of replies that I know were posted.

subject: Rate limit is shared unexpectedly between two keys
text: We mint two separate API keys for two services and both are hitting rate limits as if they share one ceiling.

subject: SSO group mapping is not assigning the right role
text: New staff coming in through SSO are all landing with the default role instead of the role their identity-provider group should map to.

subject: Scheduled report lands an hour off from expected
text: Our weekly report is set to send at 9am but keeps arriving at 8am, and we cannot figure out why.

subject: File attachment upload fails with no error shown
text: When I try to attach a file to a reply, the upload bar just sits there and nothing happens, no error at all.

subject: One customer email created two separate tickets
text: A customer says they only sent one email but we ended up with two tickets from it, and they are confused getting two replies.

subject: Migrating our workspace to the new plan
text: We would like to move to the annual plan before renewal.

subject: An installed integration will not finish setup
text: We are trying to install the calendar app from the integrations marketplace and it gets stuck on the authorization step every time.

subject: Need to restore workspace settings after a bad change
text: Someone on our team changed several workspace settings by mistake this morning and we want to revert to how things were configured yesterday.

subject: Support portal shows the wrong language for some visitors
text: Some of our customers in France are seeing the support portal in English even though we have French translations enabled.

subject: An escalation rule never fires
text: We set up a rule to escalate any urgent ticket unanswered after fifteen minutes, but nothing has ever escalated even when it should have.

subject: API pagination cursor expires before we finish paging
text: A long-running export job of ours gets a cursor-expired error partway through paging results.

subject: Exported CSV shows garbled accented characters
text: Customer names with accented characters show up as garbled symbols when we open the exported CSV in our spreadsheet tool.

subject: White-label branding is not applying to the portal
text: We uploaded our logo and colours for white-label branding but the support portal our customers see still shows Meridian’s default look.

subject: Scheduled report stopped arriving
text: Our Monday report has not arrived for two weeks.

subject: Filtering by tag returns tickets without that tag
text: Filtering the queue by the tag “urgent-billing” is showing me tickets that clearly are not tagged that way.

subject: Mobile app is not showing push notifications
text: I used to get a push notification for every new assigned ticket on my phone and they stopped a few days ago.

subject: Calendar integration is creating duplicate events
text: Every scheduled call from a ticket is showing up twice on my calendar after connecting the calendar integration.

subject: Requesting deletion of a contact’s data
text: A former customer has asked us to delete all of their personal data from our workspace under GDPR.

subject: A junior agent has more access than intended
text: One of our newer agents can see billing information that should be admin-only, and we are not sure why.

subject: How do I rotate an API key?
text: How do I rotate an API key without downtime?

subject: An action is missing from the audit log
text: A teammate says they changed a ticket’s priority yesterday but I cannot find that change in the audit log.

subject: Migrating our workspace to the new plan
text: One more thing on the plan move — the credit does not show on this month’s invoice.

subject: Sessions time out much faster than expected
text: I am being signed out every twenty minutes or so even though I am actively using the dashboard.

subject: Reconciliation report does not match our ledger
text: Our finance team is seeing a discrepancy of about four hundred entries against the reconciliation report.

subject: IP allowlist locked out the remote team
text: We turned on an IP allowlist for admin logins and now half our team working from home cannot sign in.

subject: Bulk close only closed part of the selection
text: I selected forty tickets and chose bulk close, but only about half of them actually closed.

subject: Canned response variables show as literal text
text: When I use a canned response the {{contact_name}} placeholder is not being replaced — it just sends literally.

subject: SLA clock seems to run through the weekend
text: A ticket opened Friday evening shows as breached by Saturday morning, which cannot be within our stated hours.

subject: Auto-assignment rule is not triggering
text: I set up a rule to auto-assign tickets tagged “billing” to one agent, but they are landing unassigned.

subject: Custom field values missing from the export
text: Our export has all the standard columns but none of the custom fields we added show up.

subject: Slack integration silently stopped posting
text: New tickets used to show up in our Slack channel automatically and now nothing posts, with no error anywhere.

subject: Two contact records for the same customer
text: We have two records for the same customer with different histories and want them merged into one.

subject: Password reset email never arrives
text: I have requested a password reset three times now and nothing shows up, not even in spam.

subject: Custom domain for the support portal is not resolving
text: We set up a custom domain for our support portal three days ago and it still shows a certificate error.

subject: Need a copy of last quarter’s usage data
text: Finance is asking for our usage figures for the last quarter.

subject: Search misses recently created records
text: Records created in the last few minutes do not come back in search.

subject: Two-factor codes are rejected
text: Our admin’s authenticator codes stopped working this week.

subject: Deleted a project by mistake
text: One of our projects was deleted this morning and we need it back.

subject: API returns 429 well below the documented limit
text: We are seeing rate limits at roughly half the published ceiling.

subject: Bulk import rejects half the file
text: Our import fails on about half the rows with no explanation of which ones.

subject: Timestamps are shown in the wrong timezone
text: Every timestamp in the dashboard is three hours behind for our team.

subject: Cannot add a fifth seat
text: Adding another teammate says we have run out of seats, but we only have four.

subject: Webhook deliveries stopped overnight
text: We stopped receiving webhooks around 02:00 and nothing has arrived since.

subject: Export stops at ten thousand rows
text: The CSV export cuts off partway through. We need the full year.

subject: SSO login loops back to the sign-in page
text: Signing in with our identity provider bounces straight back to the login screen.

subject: Invoice shows the wrong billing address
text: Our last invoice still lists the old office. Can you correct it and resend?

subject: Production API returning 503 for all requests
text: Everything is down for us — every call to the API comes back 503. This is affecting all of our customers.
